# Ridhant Speciality Chemicals LLP

> Rapidly emerging speciality chemicals company based in Kota, Rajasthan, India. Supplies metallic stearates, 12-HSA salts, PE and PP waxes, liquid stearate dispersions, antioxidants, fillers, food additives, stabilisers, antistatic additives and oxo-biodegradable additives to manufacturers across the globe, with application and technical support.

Contact: info@ridhantchemicals.com, +91 99294 77295. Address: Plot No. 50, New Grain Mandi, DCM Road, Kota, Rajasthan 324007, India (Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/4vucG1acEwjMCmqj7). Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm IST. Technical data sheets, safety data sheets and samples on request.

## Product families

### Metallic Stearates
Zinc, calcium, magnesium, aluminium, sodium and potassium stearates plus zinc laurate, working as lubricants, release agents, acid scavengers and stabilisers.
- Zinc Stearate: Lubricant, release agent and flatting agent; improves flow and surface finish.
- Calcium Stearate: Acid scavenger and internal lubricant for PVC and polyolefins; water repellent for construction.
- Magnesium Stearate: Lubricant and anti-caking agent with a smooth, fine texture.
- Aluminium Stearate: Thickener, gelling and matting agent for paints, inks and greases.
- Sodium Stearate: Emulsifier and gelling agent; nucleating aid for polymers.
- Potassium Stearate: Emulsifier for latex and rubber compounding.
- Zinc Laurate: Activator and internal lubricant for rubber compounds.

### 12-HSA Salts
Zinc, lithium and magnesium salts of 12-hydroxystearic acid (12-HSA) for grease thickening, lubrication and mould release.
- Zinc 12-Hydroxystearate: Zinc salt of 12-hydroxystearic acid (12-HSA); lubricant and release agent for polymers and rubber.
- Lithium 12-Hydroxystearate: Lithium 12-HSA soap; the standard thickener for multipurpose and high-temperature lithium greases.
- Magnesium 12-Hydroxystearate: Magnesium 12-HSA salt; lubricant and thickening agent for greases and polymer processing.

### Liquid Dispersions
Water-based calcium and zinc stearate dispersions.
- Calcium Stearate Dispersion: Water-based dispersion for paper coatings, gypsum and waterproofing.
- Zinc Stearate Dispersion: Water-based anti-tack and release dispersion; matting for coatings.

### PE & PP Waxes
LDPE- and HDPE-based waxes, PP wax, oxidised PE wax and PE wax emulsions.
- PE Wax (LDPE & HDPE): Processing aid and dispersant for masterbatch, PVC and hot melt road marking paint.
- PP Wax: High-melt wax for masterbatch dispersion and slip.
- Oxidised PE Wax: External lubricant for rigid PVC; adds gloss and release.
- PE Wax Emulsion: Adds scuff resistance, slip and water repellency to coatings, inks and paper.
- EBS Wax: Ethylene bis-stearamide for slip, anti-block and mould release.

### Antioxidants
Primary and secondary antioxidants that protect polymers and oils from heat and oxidation.
- Antioxidant 1010: Primary phenolic antioxidant for long-term thermal stability.
- Antioxidant 168: Phosphite secondary antioxidant for processing stability.
- Antioxidant 225 & Blends: Synergistic 1010/168 blends for polyolefins.

### Fillers & Minerals
Talc, Calcium Hydroxide, Calcium Oxide and Calcium Carbonate
- Talc: Reinforcing filler and nucleator; improves stiffness and processing.
- Calcium Hydroxide (Hydrated Lime): Alkaline filler and neutraliser for construction products, PVC compounds and rubber.
- Calcium Oxide (CaO): Moisture scavenger for desiccant masterbatch and construction products.
- Calcium Carbonate (CaCO₃): Cost-effective filler that adds stiffness and opacity to plastics, paints, rubber, paper and construction products.

### Food Additives
Calcium Propionate / Sodium Propionate / GMS-SE / GMS-NSE
- Calcium Propionate: Mould inhibitor for bread and bakery products.
- Sodium Propionate: Preservative for bakery, dairy and processed foods.
- GMS-SE / GMS-NSE: Glycerol monostearate, self- and non-self-emulsifying, for food and cosmetic emulsions.

### Stabilisers
PVC Stabilisers / UV Stabilisers
- PVC Stabilisers: Heat stabiliser systems for pipes, profiles and cables.
- UV Stabilisers: Protects polymers and coatings against sunlight degradation.

### Antistatic Additives
GMS 90/95
- Glycerol Monostearate (GMS 90/95): Distilled monoglyceride; antistatic and anti-shrink agent for EPE foam and polyolefin films.

### Oxo-Biodegradable Additives
CES / COS / MNS
- CES: Oxo-biodegradable additive grade that helps polyolefin films and packaging break down after use.
- COS: Oxo-biodegradable additive grade that helps polyolefin films and packaging break down after use.
- MNS: Oxo-biodegradable additive grade that helps polyolefin films and packaging break down after use.

### Other Speciality Additives
Other speciality additives are sourced on request; email info@ridhantchemicals.com with the grade and application.

## Industries served

- Polyolefins: Stabilisation packages for polyolefin producers and processors, built on phenolic and phosphite antioxidants.
- Plastics: Our broadest range: metallic stearates, waxes, antioxidants, stabilisers and fillers for polyolefins, PVC, masterbatch and engineering plastics. We help processors improve melt flow, surface finish and long-term stability.
- Construction: Water repellents, PVC stabilisers, fillers and moisture scavengers for gypsum, waterproofing compounds, pipes and profiles.
- Paints: PE waxes for hot melt thermoplastic road marking paint, plus matting agents, thickeners, fillers and UV stabilisers for decorative and industrial paints.
- Hot Melt Adhesives: PE and PP waxes that control viscosity, open time and setting speed, antioxidants for heat stability in the melt pot, and calcium carbonate as a cost-effective filler for packaging, bookbinding and product-assembly hot melts.
- Paper: Calcium stearate dispersions, wax emulsions and talc for paper and board coatings, giving better runnability, less dusting and improved water resistance.
- Ink & Coatings: Wax emulsions, stearate dispersions and matting agents for slip, scuff resistance and controlled gloss in printing inks and industrial coatings.
- Personal Care: Stearates, talc and GMS for creams and powders, with smooth texture and stable emulsions.
- Lubricants: Thickeners and antioxidants for greases and industrial lubricants, including lithium 12-hydroxystearate, aluminium stearate and calcium stearate.
